visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with glasses sits at a brown upright piano in a bright room with white tiled walls. He wears a plain black t-shirt and looks stressed while attempting to play. Purple lightning-bolt graphic effects are overlaid on the screen, flickering around him. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the boy adjusting his glasses, looking down dejectedly. A dark vignette effect surrounds the frame, emphasizing a somber mood as he sits still before the instrument. (3) A woman's hand enters from the left and slaps the back of the boy's head. The boy flinches and ducks his head down, touching the spot where he was struck while still seated at the piano bench. (4) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black top and a black leather skirt, appears beside the boy. She looks down at him with a slight, knowing smile while adjusting her own shirt collar. (5) A close-up shows the boy looking up towards the woman. The background is now a bright, pink-hued sparkly graphic field, indicating a shift in the visual tone and atmosphere. (6) Both the boy and the woman are now wearing matching, oversized white fuzzy coats. They sit together on the colorful piano bench and begin playing a fast-paced piece on the piano with synchronized movements. Pink sparkles and light trails swirl around them. (7) The camera provides a top-down view of four hands—the boy's and the woman's—moving rapidly across the piano keys. The lighting is bright and the motion is energetic. (8) The duo continues to play together, looking at each other and smiling. The boy now appears confident and happy, wearing his glasses and the fuzzy coat. The scene is filled with glowing pink visual effects. (9) The final phase shows the boy and the woman looking directly into the camera lens. The woman points her finger toward the viewer while they both maintain a confident pose at the piano.
